metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the bough on the porch, the comedy under the cloak, the hen, and two mended words.

yesterday: The one bough is still over the door. It is drooping.
The comedy is at Field's, to come back before Tuesday. The chronicle is still on the board. Gib was on the stair.
Two words were mended, beau to bien and sire to madame. No price was spoken for the Plutarch. No day was promised for the chronicle.
The court went down yesterday. You already knew. The night page still says the uncles may not all sing.
